resolved_findings.issue: Duplicate existing-owner proposals silently overwrote one another.
resolved_findings.resolution: Explicit seen-owner-path guard now rejects duplicate proposals for existing and new paths; actual negative control passed.

resolved_findings.issue: Collision detection applied only to new owners.
resolved_findings.resolution: Edited identifier changes are checked for baseline/proposed collisions; actual new/edit collision controls passed. Unchanged inherited duplicates remain separately visible.

resolved_findings.issue: Local registry self-identities incorrectly required external ontology adapter.
resolved_findings.resolution: Registry branch checks self-identity, FALLBACK_REGISTRY quality and preferred-term label; valid registry passes without external adapter and each malformed variant rejects.

resolved_findings.issue: Current catalog was called frozen without whole maintained-tree drift guard.
resolved_findings.resolution: git diff BASE plus git ls-files --others without exclusion filters guard tracked and ignored/untracked maintained changes. Both refusal controls passed.

resolved_findings.issue: Validation checks were serialized as passed without checking their results.
resolved_findings.resolution: Builder now asserts actual command receipt exits and log hashes, overlay PASS, structural PASS, and explicit absence of scientific approval by mechanical audit. Failed exit, changed output, failed structural/overlay status and false scientific-approval claims reject in unchanged AST-prefix controls.

script_assessments.notes: Reads exact final reviewer fragment hashes, requires complete review status and per-case set equality, asserts all188 case identities/unique IDs, copies exact evidence/proposal payload references. Permitted changes to combined decision copies are independent-review pointers, publication scope, and filed issue references. Separate structural auditor validates evidence, source and payload byte bindings. This is assembly, not independent science or full owner approval.

Targets exact frozen snapshot rows with existing owner paths only; no owner is invented for source-only cases. Formal completed/needs_curation/self_review accurately describes root consolidation; all full-owner/export holds remain. Validation receipts must be actual final command outputs; final report production still belongs to root.

Checks prospective bytes, before/frozen/current identity, new collision introductions, component partonomy delta, ontology labels or explicit registry identity. Strict LinkML is a separate required gate. MICRO fallback independently checked against exact captured OLS hash, identifier, obsolete/defining flags, canonical label and true original timestamp; exercised registry/collision controls reran against final fallback-containing script bytes. The MICRO fallback itself was statically inspected, not covered by these fixture tests.

limitations: Negative controls use isolated fixture trees and mocked git metadata; they do not replace final actual maintained-tree checks.
Native controls execute unchanged AST prefix through gates, not a fabricated scientific report.
This process review does not certify final native saved output or commit/push; final root assembly is reviewed separately.
